(2) The woman stands in front of a restaurant named "老串角" (Lao Chuan Jiao). She points upwards towards the sign. The building has a traditional Japanese style with lanterns and wooden siding. (4) The woman is seen eating a meat skewer and then drinking a colorful iced beverage through a straw. She sits at a wooden table with other diners and Japanese posters in the background. (5) She continues tasting different foods, including grilled fish. She gives a thumbs-up and claps her hands together in a thankful gesture, showing high satisfaction.
